name: Strange Functions
justification: Lovely one-liner once you see g(x) = 10^(trailing zeros of x); answer is just len(n).
solution_sketch: f(f(x)) strips trailing zeros, so g(x)=10^z where z = number of trailing zeros. For x <= n (n has L digits) every z in 0..L-1 is reachable via 10^z, so the answer is the digit count of n.
